newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana Stock Exchange little moved in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana Stock Exchange little moved in modest trade.

text.p: Shares on the Ghana Stock Exchange were little moved in moderate Wednesday trade. The All-Share Index gained 0.12 points to 382.85.
Total market capitalisation climbed to 3,295.05 billion cedis from 3,294.89 billion on Monday. Offers exceeded bids by 994,330 shares to 254,020.
A moderate 114,030 shares were traded, up from Monday's 33,040 shares. The biggest trade was 94,000 shares in Home Finance Company, which was unchanged at 130 cedis.
Metalloplastica Ghana fell seven cedis to 130, Standard Chartered Bank fell 30 cedis to 5,500, and CFAO fell one cedi to 24.
The exchange's second biggest equity, Ghana Commercial Bank, continued its firm run, rising four cedis to 742, and Pioneer Aluminium Factory rose two to 152.
